body.message:
Thank you for your message and for your kind words. We truly appreciate your offer to promote our company.

We have already checked with the management, and the response remains the same as mentioned in our previous message. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide a guarantee for a replacement apartment in City Walk or Downtown, as future availability cannot be guaranteed.

However, if such a situation ever arises, we will inform you at least one month in advance and will do our very best to assist you in finding the best possible solution.

If this arrangement does not meet your requirements, we completely understand. In that case, we will release the apartment that has been reserved exclusively for you.

Thank you once again for your understanding, and we hope to have the opportunity to host you.
